title_candidates: Claude Corps turns AI fluency into a paid fellowship
summary: Anthropic launched Claude Corps, a paid national fellowship for early-career people who want to bring AI support to nonprofits and community organizations.

primary_source.title: Introducing Claude Corps
primary_source.author: Anthropic
key_facts: Anthropic launched Claude Corps as a national fellowship for early-career people.
The program is focused on applying AI to community and mission-driven work.
Anthropic links to an application page and says relocation support is available as needed.

prerequisites: Interest in nonprofit, community, or public-interest work
A current resume or LinkedIn profile

steps.instruction: Read the eligibility and application details, then prepare one example of safe AI use in a community workflow.

risk_flags: Program details may change as applications and placements proceed.
